# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io describes itself as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)). Its GitHub org, incident-io, lists incident.io as its website ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals

- eas.json is committed in incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- package.json pins react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under .github/workflows ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).
- incident.io is hiring for React Native: "incident.io | London, UK or Remote (UK) | Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native) | REMOTE | https://incident.io/careers" ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app with 174 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). The profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). No title, role, or location is listed.
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), 92 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). The profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). No title, role, or location is listed.
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), 45 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). The profile lists company "incident.io" and website https://incident.io ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). No title, role, or location is listed.

## Why now

on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)), and the App Store listing shows 5 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — you have 174 commits in on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)), and issue 214 there is still open: "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)). Issue 198 tracks the upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)) while the app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). When that Xcode image change broke the iOS build, did you pin the image in eas.json or hold the SDK 53 branch until it passed?
